caseName: Arkansas Writers' Project, Inc. v. Ragland
caseNameFull: Arkansas Writers' Project, Inc. v. Ragland, Commissioner of Revenue of Arkansas

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Ark. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 476 U. S. 1113.] Motions for *1049leave to file briefs as amici curiae filed by the following are granted: City & Regional Magazine Association, Time Inc., Magazine Publishers Association, Times Mirror Co. et al., American Civil Liberties Union Foundation et al., and Miami Herald Publishing Co. et al.
